article.headline: Cal Baptist takes down Abilene Christian 60-54
article.description: — Dominique Daniels Jr. scored 17 points as California Baptist beat Abilene Christian 60-54 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Cal Baptist takes down Abilene Christian 60-54

categories.description: California Baptist Lancers @ Abilene Christian Wildcats

event.description: California Baptist Lancers @ Abilene Christian Wildcats

keywords: California Baptist Lancers @ Abilene Christian Wildcats
article.story: ABILENE, Texas -- — Dominique Daniels Jr. scored 17 points as California Baptist beat Abilene Christian 60-54 on Saturday night. Daniels shot 5 for 16 (1 for 6 from 3-point range) and 6 of 9 from the free-throw line for the Lancers (9-9, 2-2 Western Athletic Conference). Adam Moussa scored 11 points while shooting 5 for 9, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc and added seven rebounds. Javonte Johnson had nine points and shot 1 for 3 from beyond the arc and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line. Quion Williams and Leonardo Bettiol each scored 12 points for the Wildcats (8-11, 0-4) with 12 points. Dontrez Williams recorded 10 points, six rebounds and two steals. The Wildcats extended their losing streak to six in a row. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
